verdict.rationale: Medusa's core commerce modules are open-source and freely available on npm under the MIT license, the docs describe installing Medusa yourself, and a Medusa CLI is documented, so the core product can clearly be run on your own infrastructure. Community sources treat it as an open-source, self-runnable Shopify alternative, and a team member discusses deployment considerations such as background workers. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party self-hosting or deployment guide in the evidence (the pricing material centres on managed Cloud, with BYOC tied to an Enterprise License), and independent hands-on reports of production self-hosting.
